sn35.241:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ayojkadhāyaṃ viharati gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre.
sn35.241:1.2: addasā kho bhagavā mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānaṃ.
sn35.241:1.4: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave amuṃ mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānanti?
sn35.241:1.6: sace so bhikkhave dārukkhandho na orimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchati, na pārimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchati, na majjhe saṃsīdissati, na thale ussīdissati, na manussaggāho bhavissati, na amanussaggāho bhavissati, na āvaṭṭaggāho bhavissati, na antopūti bhavissati:
sn35.241:1.7: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave dārukkhandho samuddaninno bhavissati, samuddapoṇo samuddapabbhāro.
sn35.241:1.9: samuddaninno bhikkhave, gaṅgāya nadiyā soto, samuddapoṇo, samuddapabbhāro.
sn35.241:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, sace tumhepi na orimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchatha na pārimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchatha,
sn35.241:2.2: na majjhe saṃsīdissatha, na thale ussīdissatha, na manussaggāhā hessatha, na amanussaggāhā hessatha, na āvaṭṭaggāhā hessatha, na antopūti bhavissatha.
sn35.241:2.3: evaṃ tumhe bhikkhave, nibbānaninnā bhavissatha, nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā.
sn35.241:2.6: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.241:2.7: kinnu kho bhante, orimaṃtīraṃ? kiṃ pārimaṃtīraṃ? ko majjhe saṃsādo? ko thale ussādo? ko manussaggāho? ko amanussaggāho? ko āvaṭṭaggāho? ko antopūtibhāvoti?
sn35.241:3.1: orimaṃtīranti kho bhikkhu, channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.241:3.2: pārimaṃtīranti kho bhikkhu, channetaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.241:3.3: majjhe saṃsādoti kho bhikkhu, nandīrāgassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.241:3.4: thale ussādoti kho bhikkhu, asmimānassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.241:4.2: idha bhikkhu, gihīhi saṃsaṭṭho viharati, sahanandī, sahasokī, sukhitesu sukhito, dukkhitesu dukkhito, uppannesu kicca karaṇīyesu attanā voyogaṃ āpajjati.
sn35.241:5.2: idha bhikkhu, ekacco aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati: ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ti.
sn35.241:5.4: āvaṭṭaggāhoti kho bhikkhu, pañcannetaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.241:6.2: idha bhikkhu, ekacco dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo. asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.
sn35.241:7.1: tena kho pana samayena nando gopālako bhagavato avidūre ṭhito hoti.
sn35.241:7.2: atha kho nando gopālako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.241:7.3: ahaṃ kho bhante, na orimaṃtīraṃ upagacchāmi, na pārimaṃtīraṃ upagacchāmi, na majjhe saṃsīdissāmi, na thale ussīdissāmi, na manussaggāho gahissati, na amanussaggāho gahissati, na āvaṭṭaggāho gahissati, na antopūti bhavissāmi.
sn35.241:7.4: labheyyāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn35.241:7.5: tena hi tvaṃ nanda, sāmikānaṃ gāvo nīyyādehīti
sn35.241:7.8: atha kho nando gopālako sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyādetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.241:7.10: labheyyāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn35.241:7.11: alattha kho nando gopālako bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alatthūpasampadaṃ;
sn35.241:7.12: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā nando eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi, khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ ittatthāyāti abbhaññāsi,
sn35.241:7.13: aññataro ca panāyasmā nando arahataṃ ahosīti.
